definitions.explanation: The precious metal platinum, used in jewelry, industrial applications, and as an investment asset. In Japanese, also widely used figuratively to describe the highest-tier or most exclusive category of products, services, and membership levels.

examples.japanese: プラチナの{指輪|ゆびわ}をプレゼントした。
examples.english: I gave a platinum ring as a present.

examples.japanese: プラチナ{会員|かいいん}になると{特別|とくべつ}な{特典|とくてん}がもらえる。
examples.english: If you become a platinum member, you can receive special benefits.

examples.japanese: あのコンサートのチケットはプラチナチケットで、{入手|にゅうしゅ}するのが{非常|ひじょう}に{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Tickets for that concert are platinum tickets — extremely difficult to get.

notes:
USAGE: プラチナ is a loanword from Spanish/Portuguese "platina." It refers both to the metal and, figuratively, to the most exclusive or hard-to-get category.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プラチナ{会員|かいいん} (platinum member)
- プラチナカード (platinum credit card)
- プラチナチケット (platinum ticket — a ticket that is extremely hard to obtain)
- プラチナ{世代|せだい} (platinum generation — active senior citizens)
- {白金|はっきん} (platinum — the formal/scientific term, less common in everyday use)

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, プラチナ is used as the top tier in loyalty programs and credit cards (above ゴールド/gold), and プラチナチケット has become a common expression for any highly sought-after, near-impossible-to-get ticket.
